_note: Curated by looking at each picture. Only entries listed here are used. Rejected on purpose: Georgia, England, China, India and North America (SVG flags or locator maps), and Boston Harbor (dense topographic map, too large and not readable for young readers).

images.alt: A calm lake with green trees along the shore and tall city buildings behind, all reflected in the water.
Tall skyscrapers in a city downtown with a highway and green trees, seen from above under a cloudy sky.
A narrow cobblestone street between red brick houses with flower boxes, old-fashioned street lamps and an American flag.

images.artist: Jeff Schmaltz, NASA MODIS Rapid Response Team
images.alt: A satellite picture of the island of Great Britain, green land surrounded by dark blue sea, with Ireland on the left.
Golden farm fields and a wooded hill with green trees under a blue sky.
Tower Bridge lit up at sunset over the River Thames, with tall buildings of London in the distance.
